title: Favourite pianists
summary: He loved Oscar Peterson, Art Tatum, Nat Cole and Phineas Newborn.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Did you have anybody that you liked as a pianist, that you listened to a lot?

Oh man, I like Oscar Peterson, man. I was crazy about Oscar Peterson. I saw the greatest piano player in the world, Teddy Wilson. Not Teddy Wilson. He was good. I met him down here in New Orleans. But his blind, Art Tatum.

Sure. Art Tatum. I didn't meet him but I was in Los Angeles at the time. And I went to the theater, you know like you go in, and I caught the last part of the movie. I said, well I want to see how this thing started. And then before this thing started the lights came on the stage and all the man said, ladies gentlemen, Art Tatum, that's all he said. And that man sat up there and he played as much piano for the time he was up there man, I said, I got a piano ringing in my ears for a-
If you want to, and you know you're never going to be as good as that.
